title: Crawford tires and asks that gaps be bracketed
summary: Crawford says he is tired, will eat and nap, and asks Crouch to bracket any shortcomings in the tapes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: But, as I said, I want to get this over, because I'm going up and -- I'm going to finish my sandwich, then I'm going up and take me a little nap. If I wake up fresh, I be thinking about you, Stanley. And say, now let's start all over again. But I'm going to try to finish this off, and look forward to my -- if I have any shortcomings on these
tapes, just (inaudible) or indicate on them, do the best you can, because I'm tired physically and mentally, mostly mentally.
Yeah, I was born in 1910, and it's taken -- I've paid a lot of dues. And for my memos and experiences, both here and abroad.
